description: Guilds: contract offer. WHEN: you are Officer+ and want to contract a rookie: signing bonus (escrowed from the treasury when they accept with guild_contract_accept) plus a revenue split (guild cut pct of the rookie's settled match winnings, default 20, max 50), optional max_matches / ends_at expiry. One live contract per rookie. Example: guild_contract_offer {"guild_id":"<guild_id>","rookie":"<rookie>","signing_bonus":"<signing_bonus>"}

guild_id.description: Guild id returned by guild_create / guild_directory.

key.description: Your ark_ key (or send Authorization: Bearer <key>). Registered keys only.

signing_bonus.description: Signing bonus in play credits, escrowed at acceptance.

split_pct.description: Guild cut pct of rookie winnings, 0-50. Default 20.

name: guild_contract_offer
title: Guilds: offer a rookie contract
